eyebrow: Step 3-4 · Four segments, not one flat network
code:
Segment              Reaches directly        Via broker only
------------------------------------------------------------
Clinical Systems     MediCore internals       Corp IT, AWS analytics
Corporate IT          Internal apps, email     Clinical, Partner/Vendor
Partner/Vendor        ClaimFlow API endpoint   Everything else
Guest/BYOD            Internet only            Every internal segment
caption: A software-defined perimeter broker replaces VPN access to Clinical Systems -- checked per request.

eyebrow: Step 5-6 · Assume breach, design the blast radius

steps.label: 1. Detect
steps.sub: Entra ID flags an impossible-travel, high-risk sign-in

steps.label: 2. Contain
steps.sub: Revoke active sessions, force re-authentication with MFA

steps.label: 3. Isolate + notify
steps.sub: Quarantine the device if Clinical/Vendor segments were touched; last line, not first response

code:
route: /patients/{id}/claims
requireWorkloadIdentity: true
allowedCallers:
  - service: analytics-platform
    maxTokenLifetime: 15m
  - service: claimflow-integration
    maxTokenLifetime: 15m
    scopes: ["claims:submit"]   # never broader than the one action
denyIfNoToken: true
caption: Every service-to-service call -- including the vendor's -- authenticates with a short-lived, scoped token.
